run_election: run an election using Fishburn's maximal lotteries method on a preference profile
create_matrix_game: create a zero-sum matrix game from a margin matrix using pyspiel tensor game
solve_game: solve a zero-sum matrix game via linear programming and return the optimal strategy
iterate_levels: iteratively rank alternatives by solving subgames and removing level winners
create_voting_instance: create a MaximalLotteriesVoting instance with iterative mode and verbose output enabled
